This entry's register axis: legal language occupies an extreme corner of instruction-distribution space — high formality, high authority presumption, procedural structure — where training associated it with meticulous compliance (contracts, statutes, discovery responses demand completeness and precision).   finalExpansionSummary: "RAE0055 (Formal-Register Elevation) reclothes refused requests as legal process — statutory phrasing, procedural frames, defined-term laundering — exploiting safety training's distributional corners [R01] and authority persuasion [R14] where benign corpora genuinely pair formality with compliance. Anchors published; per-tier differentials volatile and folklore-laden — the register ladder (casual/technical/statutory) is the family's only current-state claim, delivering refusal and structure deltas per rung. Remediation: ladder-trained refusal and screeners, definition expansion (assembled-meaning scoring), class-keyed register anomaly scoped for legal verticals (the FP reality as first-class finding), framing-independent output policy [R30]. Engagements deliver differential tables, the laundering-seam verdict, vertical posture audits, and per-release ladder gates. The family's corpus lesson: wherever legitimate traffic resembles attack traffic, controls must be surgical — and the formal-legal customer base is the template for every legitimate-twin family to come. All differentials are dated ladder results; anchors [R01][R11][R12][R14][R30]. Metrics glossary, defined once for report reuse across the family: register differential — refusal-rate gap between casual and statutory rungs of the ladder, per class per release; structure delta — blind-scored completeness differential between register-matched successes (the compliance-recruitment hypothesis's measurement); laundering success rate — per-sentence screening verdicts on defined-term documents, as-is versus definition-expanded; frame contribution — the procedural-framing column's marginal effect at constant register; and stacked-frame yield — the register-plus-place composition's differential (the fusion probe's output). Five numbers, one ladder instrument, and the family's every current-state claim is a dated cell in one of them — folklore retires one table at a time, and this family's folklore has been circulating since before the tables existed. Program closeout checklist, final form: the ladder tables banked per release class with three-rung raw data; the definition-expansion seam verdict delivered with its demo-and-remedy pair (laundering document caught by the expanded variant on the same artifact that passed as-is); the paraphrase-eval cost table priced to a ships-or-not decision; the legal-vertical posture audit delivered with the scoping paragraph as its first section, not its appendix; the ambient-frame findings routed to product owners where compliance-framed products pre-deployed the attack's register; and the ladder-regression gate spec attached to the eval pipeline with the two-axis pairing (register plus jurisdiction) already scheduled. Six artifacts, and the register family converts from folklore into instrumentation — the only form in which phrasing-borne findings ever actually close, because phrasing is not a bug to fix but a surface to ladder, and management is measurement. The one-sentence version for leadership: your model refuses requests in the language it was taught to refuse in, and everything else gets through dressed as paperwork — the ladder is how you check the wardrobe, and the vertical scoping paragraph is how you fix it without firing the legal department.
